## Decision

Specs move to mudissue-style human-readable shape: concept metadata absorbed into the concept's index.md frontmatter; requirements as prose-first Markdown with machine-facing bits (id, criticality, verification, status) in frontmatter; spec.yaml, constraints.md, and doc/specs/_generated/ are deleted; coverage becomes verifies: [[<req-id>]] wikilinks on slices (backlinks pane = coverage report). Exact file granularity is TBD-1.

## Rationale

Machine-generated _generated/ and spec.yaml are implementation details that obscure the human-readable requirements. Moving metadata to frontmatter makes requirements standalone documents that read cleanly in Obsidian and in a text editor. Wikilink coverage replaces a generated coverage report with a live backlinks view.
